consumerInventory.Base: Semantic entry manifest/generated descriptor; root and existing authority/patch/reconcile hierarchy, workspace mount and evidence/policy mounts; typed native I/O remains TS.
consumerInventory.SST: Native service grants/CAS and verifier, per-literal world metadata, actor and independent native readback, actual return contribution provenance and reference-only qualification.
consumerInventory.Host: Source-claim review binder/exporter caller, canonical program-identity table if applicable, requested answer must bind actual captured root not proof self-assertion.
consumerInventory.Readers: Standard generic observed outcome/required-return roles; no capture/IR schema change intended. Python/Node unchanged unless actual compatibility proof reveals a defect.
consumerInventory.Engines: No serving/runtime/compiler feature change; same Coreef3/five SDKs. Native document protocol consumes these values through shared existing exact service boundary.
